title: Deputy Military Governor Lu

Date 21/4/16
C.S.P.
Shanghai Municipal Council.
April 14th 1916.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

（左侧竖排印章文字：CENTRAL REGISTRY）
（左侧手写批注：It is now suspected that a land mine was transported to the spot fired by a fuse. Material found was cast iron & size of bomb over 19 inches. J.O.）

Sir,
It is reported that some soldiers belonging to the Arsenal while patrolling in patrolling in the vicinity of that institution about 4 a.m. 13th instant noticed a light in an untenantcd house. They entered the premises and found two men, who had a box of bombs and a bag of gunpowder. They arrested the two men and took them to Headquarters where they were immediately tried and convicted. They were shot before day break.

It is reported that four rebels went to Woosung on 13th instant for the purpose of converting Deputy Military Governor Lu 盧 to their cause. They succeeded in getting an interview with the latter, who, on ascertaining their mission, gave orders that they should be shot which orders were immediately carried out.

It is reported that the rebels intend to start fires simultaneously at several places in the City. They propose to make an attack on the Arsenal during the commotion which results.

It is reported that the rebels have requested General Yang to declare independence. The latter only replied that he would maintain peace and good order.

At 7 p.m. 13th instant all persons on the streets in Chapel were searched.

About 3.40 a.m. 13th instant a shell fell in the country near Route Pere Robert in the French Concession. Nobody was injured, but the windows of the German Medical College and St. Marie's Hospital were broken. Some trees were also broken by pieces of the shells which seems to have been powerful and destructive.

The train service from Shanghai to Hangchow has not been resumed but trains are running as far as Sungkiang. one bet...

日期 1916年4月21日
上海公共租界工部局。
1916年4月14日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处）
警务处，
（侦探分部。）

（左侧竖排印章文字：中央登记处）
（左侧手写批注：现疑有一枚地雷被运至该处，由引信引爆。发现的残骸为铸铁材质，炸弹尺寸超过19英寸。J.O.）

先生：
据报，兵工厂所属士兵于本月13日凌晨4时许在该机构附近巡逻时，注意到一所无人居住的房屋内有灯光。他们进入屋内，发现两名男子，身旁有一箱炸弹和一袋火药。士兵逮捕了这两人，并将他们带往总部，随即进行审判并定罪。两人在天亮前被枪决。

据报，四名反叛分子于本月13日前往吴淞，目的是说服副督军卢（Lu）加入他们的阵营。他们成功获准会见卢副督军，后者在查明其来意后，下令将其枪决，该命令立即得到执行。

据报，反叛分子意图在市内多处同时纵火。他们计划在由此引发的混乱期间袭击兵工厂。

据报，反叛分子已请求杨将军宣布独立。杨将军仅回复称他将维持和平与秩序。

本月13日晚7时，闸北（Chapel，原文如此，应为Chapei之误）街道上的所有行人均受到搜查。

本月13日凌晨3时40分左右，一枚炮弹落在法租界罗伯特神父路（Route Pere Robert）附近的郊野。无人受伤，但德文医学堂和圣玛丽医院（St. Marie's Hospital）的窗户被震碎。一些树木也被炮弹碎片折断，该炮弹似乎威力巨大且具破坏性。

上海至杭州的列车服务尚未恢复，但列车已运行至松江（Sungkiang）。one bet...（原文不清）

POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Shanghai Municipal Council.

latter wishes to send an expeditionary force
against that province while General Yang wishes
to remain on the defensive.
General Yang has notified his subordinates
that any one discovered giving information as to
what is transpiring in his headquarters will be shot.
Owing to a report that Canton intends to
send warships to attack Woosung Forts all the

第 3 号
（印：上海公共租界工部局）
警务处，
（侦探分部。）

上海公共租界工部局。
191

2

希望向该省派遣远征军，而杨将军则希望采取守势。
杨将军已通知其下属，任何被发现泄露其总部内部情况的人将被枪决。
由于有报告称广州意图派遣军舰攻击吴淞炮台，兵工厂的所有巡洋舰均已顺流而下前往该地。

您忠实的仆人，

威廉·阿姆斯特朗（William Armstrong）

首席侦探督察。

警察总监。
